Sub-categories.Name: Health Insurance
Sub-categories.Description: Coverage and risk management products offered to individuals and organizations, including negotiations with private insurers and government payers.

Emotions.Name: Optimism
Emotions.Intensity: Mild = positive outlook on HCA's partnerships and revenue potential / Strong = high confidence in growth and influence in insurance negotiations

Emotions.Name: Concern
Emotions.Intensity: Mild = cautious about regulatory, market, or negotiation risks / Strong = significant worry about policy changes or payer pushback

Emotions.Name: Surprise
Emotions.Intensity: Mild = unexpected partnership announcements or policy developments / Strong = major surprise from new payer agreements or regulatory decisions

Emotions.Name: Criticism
Emotions.Intensity: Mild = subtle critique of insurance practices / Strong = strong evaluation of HCA's negotiation outcomes or payer strategy

Emotions.Name: Relief
Emotions.Intensity: Mild = easing concern after successful negotiations / Strong = significant release of tension when agreements are finalized

Emotions.Name: Neutral
Emotions.Intensity: Mild = factual reporting of contracts and relationships / Strong = fully objective coverage without emotional framing

Emotions.Name: Encouragement
Emotions.Intensity: Mild = supportive tone highlighting positive payer relationships / Strong = strong encouragement for strategic partnerships or patient-focused initiatives

Emotions.Name: Curiosity
Emotions.Intensity: Mild = interest in details of contracts or negotiation strategy / Strong = investigative exploration of payer dynamics and HCA’s competitive advantages

Sub-categories.Name: Digital Health
Sub-categories.Description: Technology-driven healthcare initiatives, including telemedicine, digital patient engagement, and health IT investments.

Emotions.Name: Optimism
Emotions.Intensity: Mild = positive outlook on technology adoption and patient engagement / Strong = high confidence in growth and innovation impact

Emotions.Name: Concern
Emotions.Intensity: Mild = cautious about tech implementation risks / Strong = significant worry about cybersecurity, adoption challenges, or ROI

Emotions.Name: Surprise
Emotions.Intensity: Mild = unexpected tech breakthroughs / Strong = major surprises from new innovations, patents, or partnerships

Emotions.Name: Criticism
Emotions.Intensity: Mild = subtle critique of tech adoption / Strong = strong evaluation of investments, ROI, or operational execution

Emotions.Name: Relief
Emotions.Intensity: Mild = easing concern after successful tech implementation / Strong = release of tension following positive adoption metrics

Emotions.Name: Neutral
Emotions.Intensity: Mild = factual reporting on digital health initiatives / Strong = fully objective coverage without emotional framing

Emotions.Name: Encouragement
Emotions.Intensity: Mild = supportive language about innovation and tech adoption / Strong = strong motivation for further investment and patient engagement initiatives

Emotions.Name: Curiosity
Emotions.Intensity: Mild = interest in digital health strategies or tech choices / Strong = investigative exploration of platforms, outcomes, and adoption metrics
